Summary
: The English translation of the Devi Bhagavata Purana. This Sanskrit work describes the Devi (Divine), the Goddess, as the foundation of the world and as identical with Brahman, the Supreme Being.
The Devi Bhagavata Purana is one of the most important works in Shaktism, a branch of Hinduism focusing on the veneration of the divine feminine, along with the Devi Mahatmya.
The work is known by the following names: Śrīmad Devī Bhāgavatam (श्रीमद् देवी भागवतम्), Devī Bhāgavatapurāṇa (देवी भागवतपुराण) or Devī Bhāgavatam (देवी भागवतम्).
